## (1.) Modify the code in Example 10.3 to automate Example 10.1 and obtain an answer (which is obviously **f(x) = 0 at x = 2)**. Begin at an initial **X0 = 3**. You should not need to modify the grad_descent function, only objects passed into the function, especially func and grad_func.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

grad_descent <- function(func, grad_func, eta, threshold, x0, show_plot = FALSE) {
  x <- x0
  keep_going <- TRUE
  step <- 0L
  while (keep_going) {
    grad <- grad_func(x)
    new_x <- x - eta * grad
    if (show_plot) {
    
    }
    if (sqrt(sum(grad^2)) < threshold) keep_going <- FALSE
    x <- new_x
    step <- step + 1L
  }
  cat("Converged in", step, "steps.\n")
  cat("Local minimum of", func(x), "found at x =", x, "\n")
  list(min_location = x, min_value = func(x), steps = step)
}


func <- function(x) (x[1] - 2)^2

# Gradient: ∇f(x) = 2(x - 2)
grad_func <- function(x) 2 * (x[1] - 2)

# Hyperparameters & start
eta       <- 0.9        
threshold <- 1e-8       
x0        <- c(3)       


## Run gradient descent

set.seed(1)
gd_out <- grad_descent(func, grad_func, eta, threshold, x0, show_plot = FALSE)

## x_{k+1} = x_k - eta * 2(x_k - 2)
x <- 3
one_step <- function(x) x - eta * (2 * (x - 2))

x1 <- one_step(x)     # step 1
x2 <- one_step(x1)    # step 2
x3 <- one_step(x2)    # step 3

cat("\nFirst three manual steps:\n")
print(c(x0 = x, x1 = x1, x2 = x2, x3 = x3))
cat("f(x1) =", func(c(x1)), "  f(x2) =", func(c(x2)), "  f(x3) =", func(c(x3)), "\n")

```

## (2.) Grad student only) Modify the code in Example 10.3 to locate the minimum of the function
$$
f(x_1, x_2, x_3) = e^{(x_1 + 5)}(x_2 + 1)^4 + x_2^2x_3^2 + x_1^2 \sin(x_3)^2
$$
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
grad_descent <- function(func, grad_func, eta, threshold, x0, max_iter = 10000) {
  x <- x0
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    g <- grad_func(x)
    
    # if gradient contains NA/NaN or Inf, stop gracefully
    if (any(is.na(g)) || any(is.infinite(g))) {
      cat("Gradient overflow at step", i, "x =", x, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    new_x <- x - eta * g
    
    # convergence check
    if (sqrt(sum(g^2)) < threshold) {
      cat("Converged in", i, "steps\n")
      return(list(min_location = new_x, min_value = func(new_x)))
    }
    
    x <- new_x
  }
  cat("Stopped after", max_iter, "iterations.\n")
  return(list(min_location = x, min_value = func(x)))
}

# ---- Define your function ----
func <- function(x) {
  x1 <- x[1]; x2 <- x[2]; x3 <- x[3]
  exp(x1 + 5) * (x2 + 1)^4 + (x2^2) * (x3^2) + (x1^2) * (sin(x3))^2
}

grad_func <- function(x) {
  x1 <- x[1]; x2 <- x[2]; x3 <- x[3]
  g1 <- exp(x1 + 5) * (x2 + 1)^4 + 2 * x1 * (sin(x3))^2
  g2 <- 4 * exp(x1 + 5) * (x2 + 1)^3 + 2 * x2 * x3^2
  g3 <- 2 * x2^2 * x3 + x1^2 * sin(2 * x3)
  # prevent NaN/Inf propagation
  g1 <- ifelse(is.finite(g1), g1, 0)
  g2 <- ifelse(is.finite(g2), g2, 0)
  g3 <- ifelse(is.finite(g3), g3, 0)
  c(g1, g2, g3)
}

# ---- Run the gradient descent ----
set.seed(12)
eta <- 0.0001     
threshold <- 1e-6
x0 <- c(-5, 0, 0.5)

res <- grad_descent(func, grad_func, eta, threshold, x0)
res

```
